description: Adds country-flag emoji glyphs to Windows Segoe UI Emoji; requires system-wide (admin) installation.
pre_install: if (-not $global) { throw 'Use elevated PowerShell: scoop install -g KnowSky404/flag-emojis-for-windows; user installs unsupported.' }

script: if (-not $global) { throw 'Use elevated PowerShell: scoop install -g KnowSky404/flag-emojis-for-windows' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $original -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Missing original Segoe UI Emoji; installation refused.' }
if ($current -ine $originalName -and $current -ine $ownedName) { throw "Unknown system font replacement ($current). Restore it manually before installing." }

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target -PathType Leaf) -or (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $target -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ine (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $source -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) { throw "Existing file differs from release: $target" }
} elseif ($current -ieq $ownedName) { throw 'Active font file is missing; restore original mapping before retrying.' }
public static extern int AddFontResourceExW(string path, uint flags, IntPtr reserved);
public static extern bool RemoveFontResourceExW(string path, uint flags, IntPtr reserved);
public static extern IntPtr SendMessageTimeoutW(IntPtr hwnd, uint msg, IntPtr wparam, IntPtr lparam, uint flags, uint timeout, out UIntPtr result);
if ((Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path $regPath -Name $regName -ErrorAction Stop) -ine $current) { throw 'Font mapping changed during installation; refusing to overwrite it.' }
} catch { Write-Warning "Rollback incomplete; keep $target and inspect mapping before recovery: $_" }

if ([ScoopFlagEmojiNativeV2]::SendMessageTimeoutW([IntPtr]0xFFFF, 0x001D, [IntPtr]::Zero, [IntPtr]::Zero, 2, 5000, [ref]$result) -eq [IntPtr]::Zero) { Write-Warning 'Font notification timed out; restart Windows.' }
Write-Warning 'Restart Windows to apply the modified Segoe UI Emoji.'
if (-not $global) { throw 'Only global Scoop installation is supported.' }
if ($current -ine $ownedName -and $current -ine $originalName) { throw "Another font mapping is active ($current). Refusing destructive cleanup." }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $original -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Cannot restore original Segoe UI Emoji; original font missing.' }

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target -PathType Leaf) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $source -PathType Leaf) -or (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $target -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ine (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $source -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) { throw "Cannot prove ownership of $target; preserve package directory $dir for recovery." }
public static extern int AddFontResourceExW(string path, uint flags, IntPtr reserved);
public static extern bool RemoveFontResourceExW(string path, uint flags, IntPtr reserved);
public static extern IntPtr SendMessageTimeoutW(IntPtr hwnd, uint msg, IntPtr wparam, IntPtr lparam, uint flags, uint timeout, out UIntPtr result);
if ((Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path $regPath -Name $regName -ErrorAction Stop) -ine $originalName) { throw 'Mapping restoration did not persist; preserving font file.' }
Write-Host 'Original Segoe UI Emoji mapping restored.'
if (-not [ScoopFlagEmojiNativeV2]::RemoveFontResourceExW($target, 0, [IntPtr]::Zero)) { Write-Warning "Font resource may already be unloaded or locked: $target" }
if ((Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path $regPath -Name $regName -ErrorAction Stop) -ine $originalName) { throw "Mapping changed during removal; preserving $target." }
catch { Write-Warning "Owned font is still locked; inspect and remove after restart: $target" }

if ([ScoopFlagEmojiNativeV2]::SendMessageTimeoutW([IntPtr]0xFFFF, 0x001D, [IntPtr]::Zero, [IntPtr]::Zero, 2, 5000, [ref]$result) -eq [IntPtr]::Zero) { Write-Warning 'Font notification timed out; restart Windows.' }
Write-Warning 'Restart Windows to complete the font restoration.'

notes: Global installation changes HKLM Segoe UI Emoji mapping but never overwrites the original seguiemj.ttf.
Requires administrator privileges. Restart Windows after install, update, or uninstall.
Do not mix with the upstream installer or another Segoe UI Emoji replacement.
